questions.q: What is the difference between a customer account and a customer site?
options: There is no difference, they are the same record
An account is used only for shipping; a site is used only for billing
An account is the overall relationship; a site is a specific address and business purpose tied to that account
A site is created fresh for every order, while an account never changes
questions.explain: The account represents the overall customer relationship; sites are specific addresses/purposes (billing, shipping) under that account.

questions.q: Does Order Management maintain its own separate list of customers?
options: No — it references the same customer account and site records used in Receivables
Yes, completely separate from Receivables
Only for new customers
Only for customers on credit hold
questions.explain: Order Management reuses the same customer master data already set up and used by Receivables.

questions.q: What does the ship-to site on a sales order primarily drive?
options: The General Ledger period
The customer's credit limit
The chart of accounts
Which warehouse fulfills the order and how freight is calculated
questions.explain: Ship-to determines fulfillment routing and freight; bill-to determines invoicing, terms, and tax.

questions.q: What are the two levels that make up every sales order?
options: Price list and tax code
Header and lines
Invoice and receipt
Hold and release
questions.explain: A sales order has a header (order-wide data) and one or more lines (item-specific data, each with its own status).

questions.q: Why does a consultant need to check a specific order line, not just the header, when troubleshooting a "stuck" order?
options: Because the header never has a status
Because lines are stored in a different ledger
Because each line can be at a different stage of fulfillment with its own status
Because only the header is visible to the customer
questions.explain: Each line progresses through fulfillment independently and carries its own status, separate from the header's overall status.
